review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: It is argued that rewarding students who show improvement is more essential than rewarding learners who show the best academic results in school. Personally, I believe that both these students should be rewarded equally.

Looking first at smart students who have diligently applied themselves to their studies, after exceeding through many challenges to reach their goal, they deserve their praises and privileges. By using this way, it may encourage these students and others to study harder to win against the rewards which can help them propel towards overall academic gains. This kind of competition seen in almost every aspect of life where only the best individuals are rewarded. The students being used to this reality and thrive in the face of fierce competition enable them to gain more experience to achieve success in later life.

Turning to improving learners, they also should be rewarded. In reality, only a few intelligent students can come first and receive the rewards, cause others to think that their bloods, sweats and tears is futile because they can not surpass those outstanding individuals, prone to feeling overwhelmed and disheartened, gradually lose the incentive to study. So they should emphasize their improvements, which encourage them to be diligent in their studies, also help students to understand that they need to constantly improve themselves instead of being irrespective of how well they have been or are performing. The constant desire to outdo themselves every things benefit them more than the competitive determination to win against all others.
review.overall: Cô thấy em đã theo đúng hướng thưởng cả học sinh có thành tích cao và học sinh có tiến bộ. Em có đủ bốn mạch ý chính, đặc biệt là ý về cạnh tranh và việc các em khác dễ nản chí khi chỉ một nhóm được thưởng. Tuy nhiên, bài chưa có kết bài và nhiều câu dài đang thiếu cấu trúc hoàn chỉnh hoặc nối quá nhiều mệnh đề bằng dấu phẩy nên ý đúng chưa rõ. Em cần ưu tiên dựng câu hoàn chỉnh rồi chốt lại lập trường ở kết bài.

paragraphs: Some people believe that schools should reward students who achieve the best academic results, while others argue that it is more important to reward students who make progress. I believe that schools should reward both groups.

On the one hand, students who excel in their studies deserve recognition. Since they have diligently applied themselves to their studies and overcome many challenges to reach their goal, they deserve their praises and privileges. By rewarding these students, schools may encourage them and others to study harder to win rewards, thereby propelling overall academic gains. Moreover, this kind of competition can be seen in almost every aspect of life, where only the best individuals are rewarded. Students who are used to this reality and thrive in the face of fierce competition may gain more experience, which can help them achieve success in later life.

On the other hand, it is equally important to reward students who make progress. In reality, if only a few high-achieving students can come first and receive rewards, other students may think that their efforts are futile because they can not surpass those outstanding individuals. As a result, they may feel overwhelmed and disheartened and gradually lose the incentive to study. Therefore, schools should recognize students' improvements, which can encourage them to be diligent in their studies and also help them understand that they need to improve themselves constantly, irrespective of their current performance. The constant desire to outdo themselves benefits them more than the competitive determination to win against all others.
In conclusion, schools should reward both students who achieve the best academic results and those who make progress.

task.text:
Some people think that school should reward students who show the best academic results, while others believe that it is more important to reward students who show improvements.
Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
